weather: Warm humid tropical morning; about 29°C by noon, broken cloud, light onshore breeze. Fictional estimate.

events.action: Opening map refined to a 5 km reference grid; families and nearby survivors positioned within a compact south-shore landing area. No story time elapsed.
Controller-only map update: the Obelisk and northern freshwater spring exist but remain undiscovered. No story time elapsed.
Controller establishes an estimated opening ship-stock and personal-belongings inventory. No physical survivor audit, recovery, consumption or story time implied.
Captain Havel and officers establish controlled access to the wreck, a muster point and a shaded first-aid area. People are told not to enter the ship independently.
Manifest reconciliation begins. Medical staff prioritize fractures, deep cuts, dizziness, chronic conditions and exhausted older passengers; medically experienced passengers offer limited assistance.
First-aid equipment and dressings retrieved from accessible ship sections. Wrist and ankle fractures supported; lacerations cleaned and dressed; vulnerable survivors monitored.
First 360 L of intact bottled water brought to shore through supervised recovery rotations; vulnerable people and medical workers receive early drinking water.
120 L of emergency water packs recovered. Tarps, rope, blankets, containers and first-aid materials counted; shade and supply stations organized.
Small portions of bread and intact fruit distributed; several nauseated passengers decline or eat less. Some people consume their own carried snacks or water.
Purser Nina Kostic and safety officer Joshua Mbele reconcile headcount: 315 alive and accounted for. No missing persons identified.
Galley team recovers limited intact ready-to-eat stores, including selected hard cheese. High-risk chilled stock held; frozen rooms kept closed. Tank water remains unverified.
Several passengers ask to retrieve cabin luggage; security explains that access remains restricted. Brief disagreement at the staging area subsides; no physical assault.
Ravi Desai and Silas Greene return from a short reconnaissance near the south forest edge. They report dense vegetation and uneven ground, not a water source or landmark.
Second distribution of modest food portions and water. Rest rotations continue, though some crew and volunteers are still heavily fatigued.
Noon census: 315 alive, no new deaths. Medical station operating with limited recovered supplies; no external communications or power restored. Obelisk and northern spring remain undiscovered.

map.layout: South landing, detailed topographic schematic v2
map.note: Opening positions spatially refined; wreck access is on the shore beside the grounded ship. No story time elapsed.

pointsOfInterest.name: The Obelisk
pointsOfInterest.description: A tall, black, mysterious obelisk in the interior of the island.
pointsOfInterest.controllerKnowledge: Contains an AI tasked with helping the survivors stay alive. It knows everything about the island. Its speech and actions are directed only by the story controller.
pointsOfInterest.state: Undiscovered; no communication or action established.

pointsOfInterest.name: Fresh Water Spring
pointsOfInterest.description: A natural freshwater spring near the northern side of the island.
pointsOfInterest.controllerKnowledge: Freshwater source; the survivors do not know of it. Flow, capacity and potability have not been established.

inventory.basis: Fictional opening manifest estimated by controller, not an in-story physical count. Ship stocks are unverified and not available until recovered or safely accessed. Personal possessions and gear placement are newly established opening facts. Food quantities are net edible contents estimates; kcal estimates are approximate. No pre-audit food/water intake assumed.

lots.assessmentNote: Selected items counted and checked for obvious damage; equipment functionality and clinical use assessed as required.

rules.food: Prefer verified safe perishables first; sealed dry/canned food is reserve. No consumption without stock deduction, preparation needs, safe access and person-specific intake log.
rules.cold: Refrigerated perishables held after six hours without power unless safe temperature history is established. Closed full freezer indicative review at outage +48h, part-filled +24h; not guaranteed safe.
rules.water: Tank contents and spring do not count as available without verified safe access; no automatic water creation.
rules.intake: Advance only on controller-directed story time; consume according to appetite, age, condition, exertion, access and realistic meal/drink opportunities. Track intake separately from pre-audit unknowns.
